paper.title: MatterSim: A Deep Learning Atomistic Model Across Elements, Temperatures and Pressures

result.summary: MatterSim 是一个基于大规模第一性原理计算、通过主动学习训练的深度学习原子模型，可在 0–5000 K 和 0–1000 GPa 范围内对周期表元素进行原子尺度模拟 [abstract][S1.p3]。它开箱即用作为机器学习力场，在 MPF-TP 数据集上达到 36 meV/atom 的平均绝对误差，相比此前最优模型精度提升约十倍 [S1.p3]。模型还能以接近第一性原理的精度预测晶格动力学、力学和热力学性质，与实验相比在 1000 K 以内对 Gibbs 自由能达到 15 meV/atom 的分辨率，从而有望以极低计算成本预测实验相图 [abstract]。此外，MatterSim 可作为持续学习和定制化平台，通过微调以最高减少 97% 的数据需求完成特定任务 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：如何准确且高效地预测任意材料在实际合成与工作条件（有限温度和压力）下的性质 [S1.p1]。现有基于数据库的模型主要捕捉基态或近平衡结构，而材料性质还依赖温度和压力，导致配置空间远超当前数据库覆盖范围，从根本上限制了其应用 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: At the core of this paradigm shift is the ability to accurately and efficiently predict the properties of arbitrary materials under practical synthesis and working conditions.

However, the property of a potential candidate material not only depends on its chemical composition and corresponding near-equilibrium atomic structure, but also on thermodynamic conditions including temperature and pressure.

This results in a requirement of high predictive accuracy over an enormous configuration space well beyond the ground states or local minima of crystal structures typically captured by current databases and models, which fundamentally limits their applicability for materials design.

method.text: MatterSim 采用主动学习方法探索广阔材料空间，整合深度图神经网络、材料探索器、第一性原理监督器和集成不确定性监测器 [S2.SS1.p1]。第一性原理监督器在 GGA-PBE（对部分材料加 Hubbard U）水平上提供能量、力和应力信号，训练后的模型作为代理引导探索器采集更多结构，形成主动学习循环 [S2.SS1.p1]。模型架构主要采用 M3GNet 和 Graphormer 两种骨干网络，前者数据效率高、推理快，后者基于 Transformer、可扩展性强但推理更慢、显存需求更高 [S2.SS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: MatterSim employs an active learning approach to explore the extensive materials space, integrating a deep graph neural network, a materials explorer, a first-principles supervisor, and an ensemble uncertainty monitor

the first-principles supervisor offers the deep learning model supervision signals relating to energies, forces, and stresses on the given structures at the generalized gradient approximation (GGA) Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof (PBE) level of theory
In this work, we opt to use two primary architectures, M3GNet and Graphormer as the backbones for MatterSim.
Such a model has better accuracy and better generalizability compared with smaller models at the cost of substantially reduced inference speed and higher GPU memory requirements

experiments.text: 训练数据集包含约 1700 万个第一性原理标注结构，覆盖 0–5000 K 和 0–1000 GPa 的温度压力范围 [S2.SS1.p2]。零样本性能在多个数据集上评测，包括从 MPtrj 和 Alexandria 采样的近平衡数据集，以及从高温高压分子动力学轨迹采样的 MPF-Alkali-TP、MPF-TP 和 Random-TP 数据集 [S6.p1][S6.p2]。此外还在 MatBench Discovery、PhononDB 声子数据库、力学性质、自由能与相图、以及 118 个系统的分子动力学模拟等任务上进行了验证 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: As of the date of publication, the training dataset contains $\sim$ 17M structures labeled with first-principles computations.
the curated dataset is representative of materials at temperatures and pressures covering 0– $5000\text{\,}\mathrm{K}$ and 0– $1000\text{\,}\mathrm{GPa}$.
MPtrj-1k and Alexandria-1k are collected by sampling randomly one thousand materials from the MPtrj and Alexandria dataset, respectively.

The MPF-Alkali-TP, MPF-TP, Random-TP benchmark sets are created with increasing complexity to evaluate the models’ performance on materials under finite temperature and pressure conditions with far from equilibrium atomic positions.

MatterSim shows a strong capability in predicting stability of new materials, with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery

Fig. 4 (a) shows the benchmark results on the materials from the PhononDB, using maximum phonon frequency as an indicator, and a good agreement is achieved with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $0.87\text{\,}\mathrm{THz}$.
we randomly selected 118 systems including bulk inorganic materials, metal organic frameworks, two-dimensional materials, interfaces, molecular crystals, polymers and surfaces

findings.text: MatterSim 在 MPF-TP 数据集上达到 36 meV/atom 的平均绝对误差，相比此前最优模型精度提升约十倍 [S1.p3]。在 MatBench Discovery 上取得 F1 分数 0.83 和 25 meV/atom 的形成能平均绝对误差 [S2.SS2.p2]。声子最大频率预测 MAE 为 0.87 THz，0 K 体模量 MAE 为 2.47 GPa [S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4]。与 PBE 计算相比，1000 K 以内 Gibbs 自由能误差低于 10 meV/atom；与 200 多个材料的实验测量相比，MAE 为 15 meV/atom [S2.SS2.p5]。在 118 个系统的分子动力学模拟中，所有材料类别的成功率超过 90% [S2.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 36 meV/atom (43 meV/atom as chemical accuracy) on MPF-TP
marking a ten-fold increase in accuracy compared with previous efforts

MatterSim shows a strong capability in predicting stability of new materials, with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery
a good agreement is achieved with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $0.87\text{\,}\mathrm{THz}$
A remarkable agreement is achieved with an MAE of only $2.47\text{\,}\mathrm{GPa}$.

MatterSim achieves a sub- $10\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ error for temperatures up to $1000\text{\,}\mathrm{K}$ when compared with QHA computations at PBE level of theory
it achieves an MAE of $15\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$
MatterSim achieved more than 90% success rate for all the material families tested, exhibiting robustness over wide temperature ranges.

limitations.text: 作者指出，MatterSim 目前采用半局域原子相互作用描述，在长程相互作用主导的场景（如聚合物和多相体系）中表现不佳 [S3.p3]。数据覆盖方面，模型仅在均匀体相体系上训练，未显式包含对催化等应用至关重要的表面和界面数据 [S3.p3]。此外，模型目前仅原生支持 DFT-PBE 水平的推理，限制了其在涉及复杂相互作用（如聚合物和有机液体）体系中的应用 [S3.p3]。模型目前仅支持能量、力和应力的原生预测，纳入电荷、自旋、磁矩等更多数据模态可能进一步提升精度和适用性 [S3.p3]。

evidence.quote: it doesn’t perform effectively in scenarios where long-range interactions dominate the properties, such as polymeric and heterogeneous systems
the current model is trained only on homogeneous bulk systems, without explicit inclusion of surface and interface data that are crucial for applications such as catalysis
the model currently only naively supports inferences with DFT-PBE level of theory, limiting its use for systems involving complex interactions, such as polymers and organic liquids
Currently, the model only supports the native prediction of energy, forces, and stresses.
